properties.name: Gold Rush Snowmobile Trail
properties.activities: Wildlife Viewing, Nature Study, Angling, Orienteering, Trail Bike Riding - Motorized, Snowmobiling
properties.closure: Due to widespread damage from recent wildfire activity in the area, the Gold Rush Snowmobile Trail is currently closed between the southernmost trailhead in the Village of Clinton (GPS coordinates: 51.100511, -121.582289) to 3 km west of the BC Hydro transmission lines northwest of 70 Mile House (GPS coordinates: 51.329486, -121.488767). It is still possible to ride the trail into 70 Mile House if you are riding the trail from the north. However, use of the trail from 3 km west of the transmission lines down to Clinton is currently restricted to personnel conducting wildfire-related work or other authorized activities only. Thank you for your cooperation and understanding. Information updated Sept. 14, 2026.
